name: Aimogen – AI Content Writer, Chatbot, Editor and AI Automation for WordPress
author: CodeRevolution

sections.description:
Aimogen brings AI-powered automation directly into WordPress.

Generate content, rewrite articles, edit posts, summarize text, and create AI-powered chatbots using modern AI models such as OpenAI and Anthropic Claude – all without leaving your WordPress dashboard.

Quick Intro

Aimogen was built to make AI content generation simple, accessible, and native to WordPress.

With Aimogen, you can:

  • Generate blog posts in seconds
  • Rewrite or improve existing content
  • Summarize long articles instantly
  • Create interactive AI chatbots for your visitors
  • Work with multiple AI providers using your own API keys
  • Automate content workflows with the Pro version

The free version gives you powerful AI tools to get started immediately, while Aimogen Pro unlocks advanced automation and publishing features.

Core Features

AI-Powered Content Creation

Generate articles, post titles, excerpts, summaries, and custom content automatically using AI.

Perfect for bloggers, marketers, and content creators who want to save time.

AI Writer Inside WordPress

Write smarter directly inside WordPress.

Use AI to:

  • Generate introductions
  • Write conclusions
  • Rewrite paragraphs
  • Improve grammar and readability
  • Suggest SEO-friendly titles
  • Translate content into multiple languages

Content Rewriter

Turn existing content into fresh new versions.

Ideal for:

  • Updating outdated posts
  • Rephrasing content
  • Changing writing tone
  • Repurposing existing material

AI Chatbot

Add a modern AI chatbot to your website and allow visitors to interact with your content in real time.

Create custom chatbot personalities and provide instant AI-powered assistance.

AI Content Generation

Create content with just a few clicks.

Aimogen helps generate:

  • Full blog posts
  • Headlines
  • Meta descriptions
  • Summaries
  • Rewritten text
  • Custom AI-generated responses

Pro Features

Upgrade to Aimogen Pro to unlock:

  • Automated post generation from RSS feeds
  • Scheduled AI content publishing
  • Bulk content rewriting
  • AI image generation
  • AI-powered comments
  • Custom prompt templates
  • Advanced workflow automation
  • More AI integrations
  • Priority updates and support

Check out Aimogen Pro

Why Aimogen?

Native WordPress Integration

No external dashboards or complicated tools.
Everything works directly inside your WordPress admin.

Flexible AI Support

Connect using your own API keys and choose the AI provider that works best for you.

Built for Real Publishing

Unlike generic AI tools, Aimogen is designed specifically for WordPress content workflows.

Privacy Friendly

Your API keys remain under your control.
No hidden subscriptions or external account lock-in.

Fast and Lightweight

Built for performance and optimized for modern WordPress websites.

Disclaimer

Aimogen connects your WordPress site with external AI providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.

You are responsible for complying with the terms, policies, and pricing of the AI provider you choose.

AI-generated content should always be reviewed before publishing.

The plugin developer is not responsible for misuse, incorrect AI output, or third-party API service issues.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/aimogen/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Aimogen > Settings
  4. Add your API key for OpenAI or another supported provider
  5. Start generating AI-powered content
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI account?

No.

Aimogen supports multiple AI providers. You only need an API key from a supported provider.

Can it generate content automatically?

The free version supports manual AI content generation.

Advanced scheduling and automation are available in Aimogen Pro.

Does it support multiple languages?

Yes.

AI models can generate, translate, and rewrite content in many languages.

Is Aimogen free forever?

Yes.

The Lite version is free to use.

Will it slow down my website?

No.

Aimogen runs only when triggered and is designed to stay lightweight.

Does it work with Elementor, Gutenberg, or Divi?

Yes.

Aimogen works with major WordPress editors and builders.
